approved_scope.title: Make it obvious on a pull request when a change is still open and when it is archived
approved_scope.description: Make it obvious on a pull request when a change is still open and when it is archived
acceptance_criteria: A pull request that still has an open change does not look finished.
A pull request whose changes are all archived says it is ready to merge once the checks are green.
When I look at a pull request, I can tell whether its change is still open or already archived.
When it is not time, that same place tells me the one reason and the one command.
When it is time to archive, one command archives the change, commits that archive, and tells me that merging is the step that is left.
When more than one change is open, I am told which one to archive first.

answers.constraints: Do not withhold a merge on an open change. One sentence names the state. One command finishes the archive and commits it. Do not tell me to merge when it is not time.
